lines: Kahan ho tum, chale aao, mohabbat ka taqaza hai
couplets.en: Where are you, come to me, love asks it of you.

lines: Gham-e-duniya se ghabra kar tumhein dil ne pukara hai
couplets.en: Overwhelmed by the sorrows of the world, my heart has called out to you.

lines: Tumhari berukhi ek din hamari jaan le legi
couplets.en: Your indifference will be the death of me one day.

lines: Qasam tum ko, zara socho ke dastoor-e-wafa kya hai
couplets.en: I beg you, think a moment about what faithfulness asks of us.

lines: Gham-e-duniya se ghabra kar tumhein dil ne pukara hai
couplets.en: Overwhelmed by the sorrows of the world, my heart has called out to you.

lines: Na jaane kis liye duniya ki nazrein phir gayin hum se
couplets.en: I wonder why the world turned its gaze away from me.

lines: Tumhein dekha, tumhein chaha, qusoor is ke siwa kya hai?
couplets.en: I saw you and loved you, what other fault was mine?

lines: Gham-e-duniya se ghabra kar tumhein dil ne pukara hai
couplets.en: Overwhelmed by the sorrows of the world, my heart has called out to you.

lines: Na hai faryaad honton par, na aankhon mein koi aansoo
couplets.en: My lips hold no plea, and my eyes hold no tears.

lines: Zamane se mila jo gham, use geeton mein gaya hai
couplets.en: I have sung the sorrow the world gave me.
